channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Night out where fairytale romance blossomed returns to city venue
item.description: A night out, proving love has no age limits, is returning to a well-known bar in the city. Age UK Norwich, behind the event, has teamed up with the bar in King Street.

item.title: Vacant tea shop now under offer after more than a year
item.description: A vintage tea shop in the Norwich Lanes, which has been empty for more than a year, is now under offer Francis Darrah Chartered Surveyors has revealed.

item.title: Burger restaurant owner grateful to people of Norwich following 'amazing start'
item.description: The owners of Gozo, a five-month-old burger restaurant in Norwich, have spoken out about their successful start since launching in September last year.

item.title: Norwich man threatened to slit throats of sex worker and partner in row over cost
item.description: A man who arranged for a sex worker to visit him threatened her and her boyfriend with a knife after a row broke out over payment, a court has heard.

item.title: Foul-up should cost ministers their jobs - and not just Steve Reed
item.description: Regular readers of this column will have picked up the fact that I’m not the harshest critic of the current government.

item.title: Concerns over 'bad layout' and 'poor design' of flat plans for vacant town shop
item.description: Concerns have been raised over the layout of a vacant Dereham shop earmarked for conversion into a flat.

item.title: Flights to and from Norwich cancelled by weather
item.description: Flights going to and from Norwich Airport have been cancelled due to weather conditions.

item.title: Popular aviation museum unveils exciting piece of First World War history
item.description: The Norfolk and Suffolk Aviation Museum (NASAM), located in Flixton, near Bungay, now have a 109-year-old leather flying coat on display.

item.title: Culture bid gains momentum as key partners unite in seaside town
item.description: An exciting bid to put a Suffolk town firmly on the cultural map is gathering pace.

item.title: Antiques Roadshow gun expert will reveal his 'behind the scenes' TV tales
item.description: Beccles gunsmith and Antiques Roadshow military history expert Robert Tilney will speak at a Lovewell Blake / NFU farmers' evening in Halesworth on March 4.
